product_intent: A browser-playable illustrated puzzle adventure where the player edits the ink rules of a living book page.
audience: Players who enjoy compact, readable environmental puzzles and visually authored worlds.
emotional_objective: Make each solution feel like a small act of authorship: the world bends because the player understood its drawing.
creative_thesis: A mischievous ink creature traverses a living book by drawing one continuous line; every stroke becomes a physical law that redirects gravity, scenery, and the character's path.
anti_generic_risk: A generic faux-antique storybook or black-and-white doodle aesthetic would make the mechanic feel like a tutorial sketch. The page itself must be an active material system, and the ink-creature's expressive motion must carry the world’s personality.

style_world_dna.medium: Browser-first 2D canvas game; authored, layered vector/paint-like page illustrations with a small reviewed local-generated concept-art proof set if feasible.
style_world_dna.page: Cool ivory rag paper with deckled geometry, sparse registration marks, page seams and selective washes; avoid sepia parchment clichés.
style_world_dna.structural_ink: Blue-black carved contours, broken hatching, deliberate broad-to-hairline stroke hierarchy; the player-authored stroke alone carries a restrained vermilion accent before settling into the page ink.
style_world_dna.living_ink: A single compact, original ink-being with an asymmetric droplet silhouette, two bright negative-space eyes, a capillary tail, and a small vermilion seed. It deforms through authored anticipation, stretch, squash, adhesion, recoil and settle poses; no model-generated sprite sheet is presumed coherent.
style_world_dna.world_logic: Solid surfaces correspond to drawn ridges and closed linework. A single continuous player stroke snaps to the page-safe region, then becomes a gravity rail: its tangent redirects local ink/light carriers and forms walkable or looped traversal. Stroke edits replace or erase it and visibly redraw the page.
style_world_dna.composition: One theatrical page at a time, broad outer margins, foreground paper fibers, middle-plane puzzle geometry, distant pale wash. Gameplay silhouettes and stroke endpoints stay unobstructed.
style_world_dna.signature_moment: The player bends one vermilion stroke into a loop; a tiny airborne pigment bead follows the new curve, the ink-being clings to its underside, then flips through the loop as the page hatches itself into a new horizon.
style_world_dna.type_and_ui: Quiet editorial page folios and short marginalia in a locally available system serif/mono pair; labels appear on paper tabs, not floating game HUD cards.
forbidden: copied manuscript borders or named-artist mark-making
procedural doodles used in place of authored silhouettes
AI-generated frames treated as animation without playback review

reference_principles.principle: Relief printing makes positive and negative shapes legible through the raised ink-bearing ridge; translate this into solid stroke/platform readability.
reference_principles.adaptation_boundary: Use the general mechanics of carved contrast, not any specific print composition or maker's style.

reference_principles.principle: Illustrated manuscript figures use iconic silhouettes and staged color rather than strict naturalism; use silhouette-first creature identity.
reference_principles.adaptation_boundary: Invent the creature anatomy, page composition, and symbols; do not reuse historical imagery or borders.

reference_principles.principle: Ink and paper respond differently to moisture and treatment; use distinct crisp structural marks versus diffuse fragile washes as material cues.
reference_principles.adaptation_boundary: Translate the broad material insight into original gameplay feedback without imitating any artwork.

signature_moments: The ink-being arrives as a blot with a single curious eye, unfolds a capillary tail to inspect a dangling pigment bead, then springs toward it.
A player stroke catches a falling bead and changes its direction; the being latches to the stroke and traverses it as newly drawn terrain.
Solving the page causes a vermilion line to drain into the folio gutter while the formerly impossible scene settles into a quiet print.
medium_candidates: Authored Canvas/vector rendering for stable small-size shape control, deterministic animation, and first-party browser delivery.
One sequential local ComfyUI/Klein image generation for mood/concept exploration only, pending exact model-license verification, actual output inspection, and spare VRAM check.
Authored pose-based animation as the initial identity-safe path; consider frame assembly only for independently reviewed, semantically consistent frames.

resource_strategy.runtime_assets: Generate the first slice’s environmental geometry and character poses in code or hand-authored vectors; do not ship unreviewed model images.
resource_strategy.concept_assets: Optionally render at most three small 512-square concept boards sequentially, only if GPU headroom supports them; preserve raw candidates and prompts.
resource_strategy.model_rights: Candidate model files in local ComfyUI are identified but their exact license files and source checksums still need verification. No generated output is approved for shipping or commercial use yet.
resource_strategy.references: Use public museum pages as principle research only; no source images included as runtime assets.
resource_strategy.license_and_provenance: Track provider workflow, checkpoint/encoder/VAE identity and hashes if available, prompt, seed, settings, raw/output hashes, review decision, processing steps, and runtime-versus-reference-only state.

evidence_plan.first_visible_artifact: A browser moodboard comparing three original art grammars for the same character-and-puzzle moment; inspection at desktop and narrow viewport.
evidence_plan.implementation_gate: No broad implementation until the Founder reviews the written design spec. If approved, build start/play/solve/fail/restart in one short authored page.
evidence_plan.animation: Inspect actual running idle, draw anticipation/contact/recoil, cling-traverse, fall/land, turn, and solve pose motion at playback speed and gameplay scale; separate agent inspection from human approval.
evidence_plan.runtime: Real local browser interaction, keyboard/pointer operation, reset/recovery, visible completion, console/network inspection, and a seeded simulation path.
evidence_plan.rights: Open gate until the exact models and any optional generated concepts have reviewed terms and shipping status.
